questions.question: In your Data Analyst and Business Analyst roles at Lockheed Martin and Halo Branded Solutions, how did you gather and document functional requirements from business users?
Describe a time you identified a process inefficiency through data analysis or gap analysis. What recommendation did you make, and what was the outcome?
This role requires clearly defined user stories and acceptance criteria for custom software development. How would you translate a business need into a user story with testable acceptance criteria?
What experience do you have working with SAP, Salesforce, Access, and centralized data repositories to extract, clean, and validate data?
Walk me through your approach to investigating duplicate, incorrect, or incomplete customer records, such as the SAP and CRM data-cleanup work you performed at Lockheed Martin.
How have you prioritized reporting, data-refresh, or operational-improvement opportunities when multiple stakeholders had competing needs?
Describe the $400 million Asset Recovery project where you led six analysts. How did you manage work, monitor SLAs, and communicate progress across the team?
What technical details would you want to understand when a custom application needs to integrate with another product through an API?
When supporting engineers during development, how would you handle a situation where a technical requirement is unclear, incomplete, or changes during a two-week sprint?
Give an example of a metric or reporting solution you created—such as funnel conversion metrics, monthly metrics, or client reports—and explain how stakeholders used it to make decisions.
